card.title: Type-Safe Configuration for an LLM Client

a1.cap: Bind app.llm.* settings (base URL, model name, timeout, max tokens) into an immutable, validated configuration object, so a missing or invalid value fails fast at startup instead of at the first request.

lines: Bind app.llm.* settings (base URL, model name, timeout, max tokens) into an immutable, validated configuration object, so a missing or invalid value fails fast at startup instead of at the first request.

a1.cap: A record annotated with @ConfigurationProperties("app.llm") receives every matching property, converted to the right types (a Duration from 20s, for example).
a1.say: A record annotated with at Configuration Properties("app.llm") receives every matching property, converted to the right types (a Duration from 20s, for example).

a1.cap: @Validated with constraint annotations checks the values at startup, which is much better than a NullPointerException in production.
a1.say: at Validated with constraint annotations checks the values at startup, which is much better than a Null Pointer Exception in production.

a1.cap: Every property under app.llm binds to a component of this record.
Spring converts text such as 20s or 500ms into a Duration for you.
Constraints plus @Validated make startup fail if the model name is missing.
a1.say: Constraints plus at Validated make startup fail if the model name is missing.

a1.cap: Registering the record makes it injectable like any other bean.
Kebab-case keys in YAML map onto camelCase components such as baseUrl.
a1.say: Kebab-case keys in YAML map onto camel Case components such as base Url.
